answer: SELECT r.yr AS race_year, r.event_schedule->>'event_name' AS event_name, (d.driver_identity->'name'->>'first_name') || ' ' || (d.driver_identity->'name'->>'surname') AS driver_name, ds.px AS podium_position, FLOOR((TO_DATE(r.event_schedule->>'date_set','YYYY/MM/DD') - (d.driver_identity->>'birth_date')::date) / 365.25)::int AS age_at_race FROM driver_standings ds JOIN races r ON r.rak_id = ds.rlink JOIN drivers d ON d.drv_main = ds.drive_link WHERE ds.px BETWEEN 1 AND 3 AND FLOOR((TO_DATE(r.event_schedule->>'date_set','YYYY/MM/DD') - (d.driver_identity->>'birth_date')::date) / 365.25) >= 35 ORDER BY age_at_race DESC, r.yr DESC
note: No main-race results table exists; podium position taken from driver_standings.px (the only per-race driver rank besides sprint_results).

answer: SELECT ROUND(MAX(rate), 2) AS highest_reliability_rate FROM (SELECT unitnode, 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE st_mark IS NULL) / COUNT(*) AS rate FROM constructor_results GROUP BY unitnode HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT matchref) >= 5) t

WITH s AS (SELECT c.cstr_key, c.namelabel, COUNT(*) AS races_started, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cr.st_mark IS NULL) AS races_finished FROM constructor_results cr JOIN constructors c ON c.cstr_key = cr.unitnode GROUP BY c.cstr_key, c.namelabel HAVING COUNT(*) > 10) SELECT namelabel AS constructor_name, races_started, races_finished, ROUND(100.0 * races_finished / races_started, 2) AS reliability_rate, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY 100.0 * races_finished / races_started DESC) AS reliability_rank FROM s ORDER BY reliability_rate DESC

WITH pr AS (SELECT wheel_unit AS drv, rc_index, STDDEV_POP(msec_val / 1000.0) AS ltc FROM lap_times WHERE msec_val IS NOT NULL GROUP BY wheel_unit, rc_index) SELECT JSON_BUILD_OBJECT('surname', d.driver_identity->'name'->>'surname', 'first_name', d.driver_identity->'name'->>'first_name') AS driver_name, AVG(pr.ltc) AS avg_consistency_score, COUNT(*) AS races_analyzed FROM pr JOIN drivers d ON d.drv_main = pr.drv GROUP BY d.drv_main, d.driver_identity HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY avg_consistency_score ASC

WITH h AS (SELECT ds.rlink AS race_id, ds.acc_pt, COUNT(*) OVER (ORDER BY r.yr, r.rnum, ds.rlink) AS races_completed, FLOOR((CURRENT_DATE - (d.driver_identity->>'birth_date')::date) / 365.25) AS driver_age FROM driver_standings ds JOIN races r ON r.rak_id = ds.rlink JOIN drivers d ON d.drv_main = ds.drive_link WHERE d.driver_identity->>'reference' = 'hamilton') SELECT race_id, (acc_pt / races_completed) / driver_age AS dpv FROM h ORDER BY race_id
note: PPR interpretation uncertain: cumulative points (driver_standings.acc_pt) over running count of races he appears in; Driver Age per knowledge formula uses current date.

answer: SELECT ROUND(AVG(0.35 * 0.25), 4) AS avg_hat_trick_probability FROM qualifying WHERE px_pos = 1
SELECT MIN(msec_val) / 1000.0 AS fastest_lap_seconds FROM lap_times WHERE msec_val > 0
SELECT COUNT(*) AS single_stop_races FROM (SELECT matchidx, COUNT(*)::numeric / COUNT(DISTINCT wunit) AS avg_stops_per_car FROM pit_stops GROUP BY matchidx) t WHERE avg_stops_per_car < 1.5

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dominant_victories FROM sprint_results a JOIN sprint_results b ON a.matchref = b.matchref WHERE (a.sprint_performance->>'final_position')::int = 1 AND (b.sprint_performance->>'final_position')::int = 2 AND ((b.sprint_performance->'timing'->>'duration_ms')::bigint - (a.sprint_performance->'timing'->>'duration_ms')::bigint) / 1000.0 > 5

SELECT AVG(FLOOR((TO_DATE(r.event_schedule->>'date_set','YYYY/MM/DD') - (d.driver_identity->>'birth_date')::date) / 365.25)) AS avg_sprint_winner_age FROM sprint_results s JOIN races r ON r.rak_id = s.matchref JOIN drivers d ON d.drv_main = s.unitdrive WHERE (s.sprint_performance->>'final_position')::int = 1
